_comment: Shop catalog for profile cosmetics. Prices are in NX (the wallet's currency, up to 2 decimals). 'id' is what gets stored in users.avatar_decoration / users.card_decoration (a profile_effect item sets users.profile_effect to 1 while equipped) and is also the CSS hook (data-decoration / data-card-decoration), so renaming an id means renaming it in public/css too. Removing an item here does NOT delete what people already own, it just stops it being sold or equippable.

items.name: Neon Edge
items.description: A pulsing neon outline around your card.

items.name: Starfield
items.description: A twinkling night sky behind your card.

items.name: Sparkle Ring
items.description: A spinning glow ring with floating sparkles around your avatar.
